cause_description: Valley oak limb broke under wet snow and wind and fell across mainline section 2; recloser R1 locked out after three operations.
High wind broke a crossarm on lateral 1; fuse F1 operated.
Ponderosa pine top fell on mainline section 2; recloser R1 locked out.
Wind-driven conductor slap; breaker reclosed successfully.
Wind toppled a weakened pole on lateral 1; fuse F1 operated.
Snow-loaded cedar limb on mainline section 2; recloser R1 locked out.
Flood water entered a pad-mount enclosure on lateral 1; fuse F1 operated.
Saturated soil uprooted a cottonwood onto mainline section 2; recloser R1 locked out.
Lightning surge failed an arrester and blew fuse F1.
Transformer CFL2101-T04 failed internally; lateral fuse F1 operated.
Squirrel contact on a cutout; fuse F1 blew.
Vehicle struck a pole on mainline section 2.
Fuse F1 melted during heat-driven peak load.
Underground riser cable failed on lateral 1.
Recloser R1 lockout; patrol found no cause.
Public Safety Power Shutoff of the whole feeder during a red-flag wind event in HFTD Tier 3.
Planned outage of lateral 1 to replace two poles.
